import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import nodePath from 'node:path';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';
import ts from 'typescript';

When('I inspect the built CLI artifacts', function () {
  const entrypoint = process.env.BDD_CORPUS_CLI!;
  const distribution = nodePath.dirname(entrypoint);
  const artifactsBeneath = (directory: string): string[] =>
    readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap(entry => {
      const path = nodePath.join(directory, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) return artifactsBeneath(path);
      return entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith('.js') ? [path] : [];
    });
  const artifacts = artifactsBeneath(distribution);
  const resolveReference = (artifact: string, reference: string): string | null => {
    const path = nodePath.resolve(nodePath.dirname(artifact), reference);
    if (nodePath.extname(path) !== '') return nodePath.extname(path) === '.js' ? path : null;
    const candidates = [`${path}.js`, nodePath.join(path, 'index.js')];
    return candidates.find(existsSync) ?? candidates[0];
  };
  const moduleReferences = (artifact: string, source: string): string[] => {
    const parsed = ts.createSourceFile(artifact, source, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, ts.ScriptKind.JS);
    const references: string[] = [];
    const staticReference = (expression: ts.Expression | undefined): string | undefined =>
      expression !== undefined &&
      (ts.isStringLiteral(expression) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(expression))
        ? expression.text
        : undefined;
    const record = (node: ts.Node): void => {
      if (
        (ts.isImportDeclaration(node) || ts.isExportDeclaration(node)) &&
        node.moduleSpecifier && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)
      ) {
        references.push(node.moduleSpecifier.text);
      } else if (
        ts.isCallExpression(node) &&
        (node.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword ||
          (ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) && node.expression.text === 'require'))
      ) {
        const reference = staticReference(node.arguments[0]);
        references.push(reference ?? './__unsupported-module-expression__.js');
      }
      ts.forEachChild(node, record);
    };
    record(parsed);
    return references.filter(reference => reference.startsWith('./') || reference.startsWith('../'));
  };
  const defect = process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT;
  let injected = defect === '0';
  const graph = new Map(artifacts.map(artifact => {
    let artifactSource = readFileSync(artifact, 'utf8');
    if (defect === 'missing-chunk' && artifact === entrypoint) {
      artifactSource += '\nimport("./missing-dynamic-chunk.js");';
      injected = true;
    }
    return [artifact, moduleReferences(artifact, artifactSource).flatMap(reference => {
      const resolved = resolveReference(artifact, reference);
      return resolved === null ? [] : [resolved];
    })] as const;
  }));
  const reachable = new Set<string>();
  const visit = (artifact: string): void => {
    if (reachable.has(artifact) || !existsSync(artifact)) return;
    reachable.add(artifact);
    for (const reference of graph.get(artifact) ?? []) visit(reference);
  };
  visit(entrypoint);
  const reachableArtifacts = [...reachable];
  const referencedArtifacts = reachableArtifacts.flatMap(artifact => graph.get(artifact) ?? []);
  const sourceComparisons = reachableArtifacts.flatMap((artifact, artifactIndex) => {
    const mapPath = `${artifact}.map`;
    if (defect === 'missing-map' && artifactIndex === 0) {
      injected = true;
      return [{ matches: false }];
    }
    if (!existsSync(mapPath)) {
      return [{ matches: false }];
    }
    const map = JSON.parse(readFileSync(mapPath, 'utf8')) as {
      sources: string[];
      sourcesContent: (string | null)[];
      sourceRoot?: string;
    };
    if (map.sources.length === 0 && map.sourcesContent.length === 0) {
      let facadeSource = readFileSync(artifact, 'utf8');
      if (defect === 'stale-empty-facade' && artifact !== entrypoint && !injected) {
        facadeSource += '\nconsole.log("stale replacement");';
        injected = true;
      }
      const parsed = ts.createSourceFile(
        artifact, facadeSource, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, ts.ScriptKind.JS,
      );
      const isGeneratedFacade = parsed.statements.every(statement =>
        ts.isImportDeclaration(statement) || ts.isExportDeclaration(statement),
      );
      return [{ matches: isGeneratedFacade, excluded: 'verified-generated-facade' }];
    }
    if (map.sources.length !== map.sourcesContent.length) {
      return [{ matches: false }];
    }
    return map.sources.map((source, sourceIndex) => {
      if (source.startsWith('<') && source.endsWith('>')) {
        return { matches: true, excluded: 'virtual-bundler-source' };
      }
      let sourceRoot = map.sourceRoot ?? '';
      if (defect === 'source-root-mismatch' && !injected) {
        sourceRoot = 'missing-source-root';
        injected = true;
      }
      const sourcePath = nodePath.resolve(nodePath.dirname(mapPath), sourceRoot, source);
      let embeddedSource = map.sourcesContent[sourceIndex];
      if (defect === 'null-source-content' && !injected) {
        embeddedSource = null;
        injected = true;
      }
      if (defect === 'stale-source-content' && !injected) {
        embeddedSource = `${embeddedSource ?? ''}\n// stale build`;
        injected = true;
      }
      return {
        matches:
          existsSync(sourcePath) &&
          embeddedSource !== null &&
          readFileSync(sourcePath, 'utf8') === embeddedSource,
      };
    });
  });
  this.build = {
    entrypointExists: existsSync(entrypoint),
    chunksDiscovered: reachableArtifacts.length > 1 && referencedArtifacts.length > 0,
    chunksComplete: referencedArtifacts.every(existsSync),
    sourceTreeMatches:
      sourceComparisons.length > 0 && sourceComparisons.every(comparison => comparison.matches),
  };
  this.defectInjected = injected;
});
Then('every reachable artifact has current source-map provenance', function () {
  assert.equal(this.defectInjected, true, `defect mode was not injected: ${process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT}`);
  if (process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '0' && !this.build.sourceTreeMatches) {
    throw new Error('Built CLI is stale relative to the source tree; rebuild dist first');
  }
  assert.deepEqual(this.build, {
    entrypointExists: true,
    chunksDiscovered: true,
    chunksComplete: true,
    sourceTreeMatches: true,
  });
});
